note: A clean fit on all five. Business owner at 29 with three children and partners in place enough that he is working on himself; health is precisely the deferred area, in his own words 'just not prioritizing the health with the little amount of time I do have left'; and the trajectory is unambiguously good-to-great — a serious bodybuilding background, 225 lb at 6'3" and roughly 16-17% body fat, targeting 200 lb at 12% with better mobility, while playing recreational football. Not remotely the excluded profile. Income is recorded as a match with a caveat: he called $6,000 'a lot pricier than I was anticipating' and said that without a write-off he would have to split the payments personally, which is real price friction. But unlike the Igor Reoutt, Nicholas Ugo and Chris calls in this batch, there is no evidence of incapacity — he is optimising the purchase, not struggling to fund it, and he stated a personal fallback. The finding worth carrying forward is not about his fit but about the mechanism: a core-ICP prospect who would probably have closed was converted into a follow-up because the rep introduced the tax write-off before the price and handed the decision to an accountant.
